title: How Portion Creep Quietly Eats Your Margin

scenes.say: A slightly bigger scoop, every plate. That's five thousand four hundred dollars a year.

scenes.speaker: Dev
scenes.say: Guests love it when I give them a little extra.
Say one extra ounce of fries costs you ten cents. Times a hundred and fifty plates a day, three hundred and sixty days a year. That's five thousand four hundred dollars.
So: give the line the right size scoop. Weigh one plate every shift. And pin up a photo of how the plate should look.

props.title: Stop the creep
steps: Pin up a photo of the plate
